target_audience: College students in India (Undergraduates, Engineering, Commerce & Arts)
purpose: Training and evaluating deepfake/synthetic profile detection models for student digital safety and scam prevention in TrustLens
label: fake_ai_generated

samples.setting: College campus courtyard with brick architecture and lush greenery in background bokeh
samples.attire: Pastel cotton embroidered kurti, natural everyday college look
samples.scam_risk_context: Impersonation of campus peer, fake WhatsApp study group or fest coordinator profile
synthetic_indicators: Slightly regular specular reflection in eye pupils
Smooth skin gradient transition under natural sunlight
Synthetic depth-of-field boundary along shoulder edges
